tools.name: npm_breaking_changes
tools.description: npm breaking changes between two versions of a package, read from its real CHANGELOG and GitHub release notes: documented breaking items per version, major bumps, Node.js engine / ESM-CJS / peer dependency changes, migration guide links and a verdict. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: npm_changelog
tools.description: npm changelog between two versions: full release notes of every version in the range (newest first), with dates, bump type, deprecations, extracted breaking changes and package.json changes. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: pypi_breaking_changes
tools.description: PyPI breaking changes between two versions of a Python package, from its CHANGELOG/HISTORY/CHANGES file and GitHub releases: breaking items per version, Requires-Python and dependency changes, yanked versions, migration guide links and a verdict. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: pypi_changelog
tools.description: PyPI changelog between two versions of a Python package: full release notes per version (newest first) with dates, bump type, yanked flags, extracted breaking changes and Requires-Python / dependency changes. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: dependency_upgrade_plan
tools.description: Dependency upgrade plan for up to 5 npm or PyPI packages: per package the breaking changes to the target version, major bumps, engine/Python and peer dependency changes, migration guides and a risk score, ordered by risk, plus peer requirements between the listed packages. Paid: $0.02 USDC per call

tools.name: npm_versions
tools.description: Free: published versions of an npm package (newest first) with publish dates, bump type and deprecations, to pick valid from/to values.

tools.name: pypi_versions
tools.description: Free: published versions of a PyPI project (newest first, PEP 440 order) with publish dates and bump type.
